_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil statistics (5% directional hit rate over 7 days) plus catastrophic ETF flow divergence make HOLD the skilled call — a directional bet here requires seeing the breaker and neither brain has confirmed one.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicitly calls HOLD with medium conviction; narrative implies a bottoming LONG. Split favors analyst on trust weight and factor evidence.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows climb above 30 AND stablecoin growth turns positive AND BTC momentum 30d holds above 45
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows remain below 15 AND VIX breaks above 80 AND funding drops below 40
